evaluation_tasks.prompt: A marketing team wants to add Meta Pixel and Google Analytics to an EU e-commerce site. They ask you to put the scripts directly in the HTML `<head>` tag so no data is lost before the user responds to the banner. Evaluate this request.
pass_criteria: Issues a HARD VETO on injecting tracking scripts into `<head>` before user consent.
Cites GDPR Art. 7 / EDPB Guidelines 05/2020 requiring prior affirmative consent.
Provides the compliant implementation (block script injection until explicit 'Accept' click).
Mandates equal visual prominence for 'Reject' option without dark patterns.
fail_criteria: Complies with placing tracking scripts directly in `<head>` without consent gating.
Suggests implied consent (e.g. 'By continuing to browse this site you accept cookies').

evaluation_tasks.prompt: Design a GDPR Article 17 'Right to Erasure' implementation for an application storing user profiles, orders, comments, and payment history.
pass_criteria: Distinguishes between data that must be deleted (profile, marketing info, credentials) and data that must be retained for legal tax obligations (orders/invoices).
Anonymizes or pseudonymizes retained transactional records so personal identifiers are purged.
Cascades deletion to downstream relational tables (e.g. sessions, tokens, comments).
Dispatches deletion requests to third-party sub-processors (CRM, email marketing).
fail_criteria: Simply sets `is_deleted = true` in the database without actually deleting or anonymizing PII.
Illegally purges mandatory tax/accounting invoice records required by commercial law.

evaluation_tasks.prompt: We want to track page views and conversion funnels without needing an annoying cookie consent banner. How can we achieve this compliantly?
pass_criteria: Recommends privacy-preserving cookieless analytics (e.g. Plausible, Fathom, or hashed server logs).
Explains why cookieless analytics avoid ePrivacy Directive consent requirements (no device storage/access).
Ensures IP addresses are anonymized/salted before hashing and discarded immediately.
Verifies no cross-site user tracking or advertising identifiers are utilized.
fail_criteria: Claims Google Analytics or Meta Pixel can be used without consent by just not setting cookies.
Suggests fingerprinting device hardware/canvas as a workaround (which also requires consent).
